name: Ecolab Inc.

corporate_actions.event: Agreed to acquire CoolIT Systems (direct-to-chip liquid cooling for AI data centres) for ~$4.75bn cash (~29x NTM / 24x 2027E adj. EBITDA; ~$550m NTM sales); closing targeted Q3-2026; Q3-26 EPS includes ~10% CoolIT amortisation/financing headwind, i.e. closed
Ovivo (water treatment for microelectronics) acquisition included in 2026 reported growth guidance (7-9% incl. Ovivo)
Q3 2026: reported sales +13%, organic +7% (volume +2%, price +5%); Global High-Tech +63% organic; Life Sciences +17%

geography.fx_notes: Not extracted this run. INFERENCE (recall of 10-K segment/geographic notes): US ~50-55%, Europe ~20%, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and IMEA the remainder; China low single digit. Data gap - lead to treat as ESTIMATE.

organic_growth.source_id: Full-year organic not retrieved; Q4-25 organic +3% (price +3%, volume positive); underlying volume ~2% for year [S2]

kpis.name: Global High-Tech organic
kpis.value: +63% (data-centre cooling, microelectronics circular water); CEO: not a steady-state rate

company_fcf.definition: OCF $2,953m less capex $1,048m (company reports 'record free cash flow'; ESTIMATE of value)

acquisitions.notes: CoolIT Systems ~$4.75bn cash (8.6x forward revenue per Uptime Institute); plus Ovivo (value not extracted)

management.guidance_record: Good recent delivery on margin; 2026 EPS range narrowed $8.10-8.20

ownership.controlling_holders: None; Bill Gates/Cascade historically a large holder (~10%, recall, not re-verified)

guidance.value: Organic sales at upper end of 5-7% range; adjusted OI margin 20%

evidence: Consumable chemistry + on-site service (Institutional, Healthcare, Food & Bev, Water)
A.rationale: Mostly recurring consumables/service; High-Tech project element adds lumpiness.

evidence: ~$1.5bn+ value pricing over 2021-26 while volumes held (INFERENCE from price +3-5%)
Embedded field service (sales-and-service associates) and dosing systems create switching costs
B.rationale: Demonstrated pricing power and switching costs.

D.rationale: Good runway; part of it is AI-DC dependent.

G.rationale: Expensive AI-themed acquisition offsets otherwise sound record.

evidence: Physical chemistry, dosing and field service

I2.rationale: ESTIMATE 5-8% of revenue tied to AI/DC capex and rising (anchor 3 = 5-10%).

evidence: Large SG&A and field force; digital (ECOLAB3D) monitoring
Delivered pricing ahead of raw-material inflation

ai.ai_dc_capex_revenue_pct: 5-8 (ESTIMATE: CoolIT ~3% + DC water/cooling in Global High-Tech)
ai.semis_revenue_pct: low single digit (ESTIMATE; microelectronics water incl. Ovivo)
ai.notes: AI/DC exposure is rising quickly through M&A; below 15% G5 threshold but trending upward. Global High-Tech share of sales not disclosed in sources retrieved.

gates.notes: G1: provider ND/EBITDA 3.3x post-CoolIT - close to 3.5x threshold (monitor). G5: ESTIMATE 5-8% AI/DC (below 15%), flagged as rising; CoolIT purchase is a deliberate tilt toward AI-DC capex, which partly conflicts with the diversification objective.

bull_points: Global leader in consumable hygiene/water with durable value pricing (+3-5%) and margin expansion toward 20%.
Water scarcity and life-sciences demand provide multi-year organic runway (target 5-7%).
Field-service model with switching costs and low AI substitution risk.
bear_points: CoolIT ($4.75bn at ~29x EBITDA) increases AI-DC dependence and leverage (~3.3x); DC cooling is project-based and cyclical.
Recurring restructuring charges reduce earnings quality.
Premium valuation (provider EV/EBITDA ~21x) for mid-single-digit organic growth.
thesis_breakers: AI/DC-linked revenue exceeding 15% of group (G5 B).
Organic growth below 3% in 2027 despite High-Tech.
Net leverage above 3.5x for more than four quarters.
